An economy starts the year with a real capital stock of 1800 billion dollars. Existing capital depreciates 6.0% during the year, and 230 billion of new investment is installed at year-end. What is the end-of-year capital stock?
explanation: New investment is installed after existing-capital depreciation: Knext = 1800(1 − 6.0/100) + 230 = 1,922.00 billion dollars.
